instances.name: Consumer Loan service (target)
instances.description: TARGET DESIGN from BIAN's container pattern: one deployable component for Consumer Loan Origination (synthetic selection), exposing its service operations as a REST API. Not built; proposed by bian-container-pattern [SAPG] §3.5 (REST mapping) + §4.1 (one deployable component per Service Domain); executor fable-executor/2026-10-22.

instances.name: POST /consumer-loans
instances.description: Reference API for Initiate Consumer Loan Origination (Initiate); create-instance term ⇔ POST on the collection (executor convention, guide check 2).

instances.name: PATCH /consumer-loans/{id}
instances.description: Reference API for Update Consumer Loan Origination (Update); Update ⇔ PATCH on the instance (executor convention).

instances.name: GET /consumer-loans/{id}
instances.description: Reference API for Retrieve Consumer Loan Origination (Retrieve); Retrieve ⇔ GET (SAPG §3.5, verified).

instances.name: POST /consumer-loans/{id}/offer
instances.description: Reference API for Execute Consumer Loan Origination Offer (Execute / Offer); Execute ⇔ POST on the qualifier sub-resource (guide check 2, v0.5.7); qualifier segment carries the behavior qualifier (check 3).

instances.name: POST /consumer-loans/{id}/agreement
instances.description: Reference API for Execute Consumer Loan Origination Agreement (Execute / Agreement); Execute ⇔ POST on the qualifier sub-resource (guide check 2, v0.5.7); qualifier segment carries the behavior qualifier (check 3).

instances.name: PUT /consumer-loans/{id}/control
instances.description: Reference API for Control Consumer Loan Origination (Control); Control ⇔ PUT on the instance's control action (executor convention; "control" is not a qualifier of this control record, so check 3 stays neutral for the other operations).
